title: SOS Collision, No Response
coverage: Safety Connect subscription active; emergency contact on file

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Safety Connect emergency. We received an automatic collision notification from the vehicle. Occupants, can you hear me?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: There is no occupant response. I cannot hear anyone in the cabin.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I hear no occupant response. I am requesting emergency dispatch to the GPS location now. Stay on the line if anyone can hear me.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Help. We were rear-ended. My chest hurts. Please send an ambulance.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Help is on the way. Stay in the vehicle with belts on unless there is fire. Do not try to leave live traffic. Are other occupants with you?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My daughter is in the back. She is crying but she is awake.
